intro.title: The classics are always here.
intro.text:
We just happen to like a little chaos in the kitchen.

Our creations are inspired by desserts we love, flavors we discover, places we visit, and things happening around the world that make us want to try something new. Some drinks become favorites and earn a permanent spot, others change with the seasons. The kitchen chaos? Is year-round.

But it all starts with a few things we care about and never compromise on: First Harvest matcha sourced directly from our farm partner in Yame, Fukuoka, Japan. Double-shot espresso, because one felt unnecessary… decaf options are available as well for all drinks. House-made creams, and some syrups. Freshly made plant milk with real ingredients, no added sugar and no preservatives. No extra charge for your milk of choice, always on us.

Babaloo is a little devotion to the everyday. A place for familiar faces and new ones.
For coffee that turns into conversation, quick stops that take a little longer,
and dogs we know by name. Nothing here is too serious. Nothing is by accident.
